name: Icon Section
description: Section with large icon and content beside it

icon.description: Emoji or icon to be displayed (large size)

content.description: Section content. Can be string or array of paragraphs

example.title: Structured Content
example.content: All content is organized in a hierarchical and progressive way, allowing you to learn from basic to advanced naturally.

renderedHtml:
📚

Structured Content

All content is organized in a hierarchical and progressive way, allowing you to learn from basic to advanced naturally.
notes: The icon-section component uses flexbox to align the icon to the left and content to the right. The icon can be an emoji or any Unicode character.
